newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-MILLER TO MAKE IRELAND DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-MILLER TO MAKE IRELAND DEBUT.

text.p: Leicester flanker Eric Miller was the only new cap in Ireland's rugby union team named on Monday to play Italy at Lansdowne Road on Saturday.
The line-up showed two changes from the side beaten by Australia last month. Miller came in for Denis McBride and Conor O'Shea replaced injured Jim Staples at full-back.

Team: C. O'Shea (London Irish); J. Topping (Ballymena), J. Bell (Northampton), M. McCall (Dungannon), D. Crotty (Garryowen); P. Burke (Bristol), S. McIvor (Garryowen); N. Popplewell (Newcastle), K. Wood (Harlequins, captain), P. Wallace (Saracens), G. Fulcher (London Irish), J. Davidson (London Irish), D. Corkery (Bristol), E. Miller (Leicester), A. Foley (Shannon). Replacements: D. Humphreys (London Irish), N. Hogan (Terenure College), D. McBride (Malone), P. Johns (Saracens), P. Flavin (Blackrock College), A. Clarke (Northampton).
